shared_elements: animal or bird figures in profile
round eye or circular mark on an animal head
horizontal or panel-like bands of pattern
justification: The strongest correspondence is that both surfaces combine schematic profile creatures with circular eyes and repeated zigzag/chevron patterning. The biggest difference is that A shows a vertically arranged set of separate relief animals and bands, while B is dominated by dense, angular, repeated bird-like/serrated motifs covering a curved surface.
